outlooks.summary: CLUSTERS OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE FORECAST TODAY AND TONIGHT ACROSS PARTS OF THE UPPER MIDWEST AND MIDWEST. ISOLATED STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE ALSO POSSIBLE OVER THE SOUTHERN APPALACHIANS AND CAROLINAS AND ACROSS PARTS OF THE SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A VIGOROUS SHORTWAVE TROUGH...INITIALLY LOCATED OVER MT EARLY THIS MORNING...WILL MOVE EWD ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS BY LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING AND INTO THE UPPER GREAT LAKES BY DAYBREAK FRIDAY. MULTIPLE CONVECTIVELY RELATED PERTURBATIONS WILL LIKELY MOVE ESEWD IN A CORRIDOR FROM THE MID MS VALLEY INTO THE CAROLINAS RELATED TO EARLY-DAY STORMS. A SURFACE CYCLONE SHOULD TRACK E OVER THE UPPER MIDWEST WITH AN ATTENDANT WEAK COLD FRONT/SURFACE TROUGH EXTENDING S INTO THE CNTRL PLAINS. A WAVY WARM FRONT /LIKELY REINFORCED BY EARLY-DAY CONVECTION/ SHOULD EXTEND ESE FROM THE LOW ACROSS THE GREAT LAKES.

sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST AND MIDWEST
sections.text: OVERALL LITTLE CHANGE IN THINKING FROM THE PREVIOUS FORECAST WITH A LIKELY COMPLEX CONVECTIVELY DEPENDENT FORECAST. MULTIPLE ROUNDS OF CONVECTION ACROSS A BROAD REGION WILL LIKELY YIELD EMBEDDED CLUSTERS OF SEVERE STORMS. AN MCS WILL LIKELY BE ONGOING AT 12Z IN THE AREA CENTERED OVER THE MID MS VALLEY. THE NOCTURNAL MCS MAY CONTINUE AND REINVIGORATE DOWNSTREAM AS THE AIRMASS DESTABILIZES VIA HEATING WITHIN A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER. LOWEST 30-MB MEAN DEWPOINTS RANGING FROM THE UPPER 60S TO LOWER 70S WILL BE COMMON IN AREAS VOID OF CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING...ESPECIALLY ON THE CAPPED SWRN FRINGE OF EARLY-DAY STORMS --YIELDING MODERATE TO STRONG BUOYANCY. A PREDOMINANT WIND RISK MAY ACROSS THE MID MS VALLEY AND POSSIBLY INTO THE OH VALLEY DURING THE DAY. IN WAKE OF THE EARLY TO POTENTIALLY MIDDAY STORM ACTIVITY...MODEL GUIDANCE INDICATES DEEP-LAYER FORCING FOR ASCENT /GLANCING 30 M PER 12 HR HEIGHT FALLS/ WILL OVERSPREAD THE DESTABILIZING WARM SECTOR NEAR THE NEB/IA/MN VICINITY. STORM DEVELOPMENT/TIMING MAY BE CLOSELY ASSOCIATED WITH A TROUGH AT H7...WITH IMPLIED MOISTENING/EROSION OF CINH. A CLUSTER OF STORMS WILL LIKELY DEVELOP DURING THE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING WITH AN ATTENDANT THREAT

sections.title: CAROLINAS VICINITY
sections.text: STORM DEVELOPMENT/TIMING MAY BE PARTIALLY RELATED TO ONE OR MORE MCV/S LOCATED OVER THE SRN APPALACHIANS/CAROLINAS DURING THE DAY. IT REMAINS PLAUSIBLE A SMALL CORRIDOR WITH ENHANCED BACKGROUND FLOW RELATED TO A MCV WILL RESULT IN A CLUSTER OF STRONGER MULTICELLULAR STORMS CAPABLE OF STRONG TO LOW-END SEVERE GUSTS CAPABLE OF WIND DAMAGE. UNCERTAINTY PRECLUDES A POSSIBLE AREA OF HIGHER-WIND PROBABILITIES AT THIS TIME.

sections.title: SRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: STRONG HEATING IS EXPECTED AGAIN ACROSS THE REGION IN AN AREA LARGELY DISPLACED FROM STRONGER FORCING LOCATED TO THE N OVER THE MIDWEST. NONETHELESS...A SURFACE TROUGH/DRYLINE WILL AID IN FOCUSING ISOLATED STORM DEVELOPMENT BY LATE AFTERNOON. A DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER WILL FAVOR ISOLATED STRONG TO SEVERE GUSTS VIA EVAPORATIVE COOLING AND WATER LOADING WITH THE MORE INTENSE CORES. ..SMITH/ROGERS.. 07/07/2016

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS APPEAR MOST PROBABLE TODAY IN A SWATH FROM MISSOURI ACROSS THE LOWER OHIO VALLEY REGION TO MIDDLE TENNESSEE...AND ALSO OVER PARTS OF THE UPPER MIDWEST CENTERED ON CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN MINNESOTA. OTHER...MORE ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS ARE POSSIBLE FROM THE CENTRAL PLAINS TO THE CAROLINAS AND THE UPPER GREAT LAKES REGION.

sections.title: THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS PORTIONS SRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: ...SUMMARY... SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS APPEAR MOST PROBABLE TODAY IN A SWATH FROM MISSOURI ACROSS THE LOWER OHIO VALLEY REGION TO MIDDLE TENNESSEE...AND ALSO OVER PARTS OF THE UPPER MIDWEST CENTERED ON CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN MINNESOTA. OTHER...MORE ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS ARE POSSIBLE FROM THE CENTRAL PLAINS TO THE CAROLINAS AND THE UPPER GREAT LAKES REGION.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: PROGRESSIVE AND NEARLY ZONAL BELT OF MID/UPPER-LEVEL FLOW WILL PERSIST ACROSS NRN HALF OF CONUS THROUGH PERIOD. MAIN PERTURBATION IN THAT FLOW FIELD IS POSITIVELY TILTED TROUGH -- NOW EVIDENT IN MOISTURE-CHANNEL IMAGERY FROM SRN SK ACROSS CENTRAL MT TO NRN UT. THIS FEATURE IS LOOSELY PHASED WITH CYCLONE OVER NWRN SK/NERN AB...BUT IS FCST TO PEEL OFF EWD AND STRENGTHEN SOMEWHAT...REACHING DAKOTAS BY 00Z AND UPPER MS VALLEY BY 12Z. TO ITS SE...SMALL SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND EMBEDDED/CONVECTIVELY ENHANCED VORTICITY LOBE NOW OVER ERN PORTIONS TN/KY IS FCST TO CROSS SRN APPALACHIANS MIDDAY...CAROLINAS PIEDMONT AROUND 00Z...AND OFFSHORE CAROLINAS TONIGHT. ASSOCIATED CONVECTION OVER TN VALLEY REGION HAS LEFT SUBSTANTIAL SFC OUTFLOW BOUNDARY AND BAROCLINIC ZONE FROM SERN AND MID TN NWWD OVER MS RIVER VALLEY OF ERN MO/WRN IL. THIS BOUNDARY MAY DRIFT NEWD THROUGH AFTN BEFORE BEING OVERTAKEN BY MCS NOW OVER MO. SFC COLD FRONT IS FCST TO PROGRESS EWD AND SEWD ACROSS CENTRAL PLAINS AND UPPER MIDWEST...REACHING WRN MN...WRN IA AND NERN/CENTRAL KS BY 00Z.

sections.title: MORNING/AFTN...ERN MO TO LOWER OH VALLEY AND TN/KY
sections.text: LARGE MCS WILL CONTINUE TO POSE THREAT FOR DAMAGING/SVR GUSTS THROUGH REMAINDER MORNING AS IT MOVES SEWD ALONG AND SW OF AFOREMENTIONED BAROCLINIC ZONE. REF SPC WW 346 AND RELATED MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS FOR NEAR-TERM DETAILS. SOME RE-INTENSIFICATION OR ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE INTO AFTN AS FOREGOING AIR MASS DIABATICALLY DESTABILIZES...ALONG AND SW OF OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE/LIFT AND STORM-RELATIVE FLOW SHOULD REMAIN MAXIMIZED INVOF THAT BOUNDARY AS WELL...AS IT MOVES NEWD AHEAD OF MCS. AS SUCH...HAVE REDIRECTED 30%/ENH WIND AREA TO THIS PATH...WHERE GREATEST POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR EITHER MAINTAINED OR DIURNALLY RENEWED THREAT FOR ORGANIZED CONCENTRATIONS OF DAMAGING GUSTS.

sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST REGION
sections.text: WIDELY SCATTERED TO SCATTERED TSTMS SHOULD DEVELOP ALONG/AHEAD OF COLD FRONT THIS AFTN...WITH LARGE HAIL MORE PROBABLE EARLY AND TRANSITION TO PRIMARY DAMAGING-WIND THREAT WITH TIME. SO FAR...SYNOPTIC GUIDANCE AND MOST CONVECTION-ALLOWING MODELS INITIALIZED FROM 00-09Z TIME FRAME APPEAR NEARLY CLUELESS ABOUT BEHAVIOR...LOCATION AND/OR TIMING OBSERVED SO FAR WITH SUBSTANTIAL MCS FARTHER S. AS SUCH...THEY ALSO ARE NOT TO BE TRUSTED WITH RESULTING STABILIZING EFFECTS ON PROSPECTIVE INFLOW TRAJECTORIES OF AFTN CONVECTION -- TRAJECTORIES EMANATING ATTM FROM THAT COMPLEX AND ITS EXTENSIVE/TRAILING PRECIP/CLOUD SHIELD. IN TURN...WHILE BAND OF STG-SVR TSTMS STILL APPEARS PROBABLE ACROSS PARTS OF UPPER MIDWEST TODAY...ITS INTENSITY...LONGEVITY AND SRN EXTENT ARE MORE IN DOUBT NOW THAN IN PREVIOUS OUTLOOK PACKAGE. GIVEN THESE UNCERTAINTIES... HAVE DIALED BACK TO 15%/SLGT UNCONDITIONAL RISK ACROSS THIS REGION...ACKNOWLEDGING THAT LOCALIZED CONCENTRATION OR CORRIDOR OF DAMAGING-GUST RISK MAY STILL DEVELOP SOMEWHERE WITHIN MN OR NRN IA LATE THIS AFTN OR EVENING. LACK OF MORE ROBUST LOW-LEVEL FLOW WILL LIMIT HODOGRAPH SIZE... EXCEPT INVOF ANY FAVORABLE MESOSCALE BOUNDARIES YET TO BECOME APPARENT

sections.title: SERN CONUS
sections.text: WIDELY SCATTERED TO SCATTERED TSTMS MAY DEVELOP THROUGH AFTN AND INTO EARLY EVENING ACROSS SWATH FROM NRN GA THROUGH MOST OF CAROLINAS. DAMAGING GUSTS ARE POSSIBLE...SOME NEAR SVR LIMITS. MRGL AREA HAS BEEN NUDGED SWD SOMEWHAT IN DEFERENCE TO... 1. PROSPECTIVE BOUNDARY LOCATION/ORIENTATION DURING AFTN HEATING ACROSS TN/GA/SC AND 2. STABILIZING EFFECTS OF CLOUDS/PRECIP FARTHER N ACROSS PORTIONS ERN KY/WV. RELATIVELY CONCENTRATED AREA OF CONVECTIVE POTENTIAL MIGHT DEVELOP ON MESOSCALE WITHIN BROADER MRGL-RISK AREA SOMEWHERE OVER CENTRAL/ERN CAROLINAS OR SRN VA. HOWEVER...COMBINATION OF WEAKER LAPSE RATES ALOFT WITH NWD EXTENT...AND CLOUD COVER FROM ONGOING SRN APPALACHIANS PRECIP AREAS...INDICATES MRGL MAGNITUDE AND TOO MUCH SPATIAL UNCERTAINTY TO ASSIGN GREATER UNCONDITIONAL-SVR RISK ATTM.

sections.title: CENTRAL PLAINS
sections.text: ISOLATED/MRGL POTENTIAL FOR HAIL/GUSTS NEAR SVR LIMITS MAY EXIST WITH MORNING TSTMS ATOP OUTFLOW POOL...UNTIL SUPPORTIVE LLJ WEAKENS. THEREAFTER...VERY CONDITIONAL SVR-WIND AND LARGE-HAIL POTENTIAL EXISTS THIS AFTN/EVENING INVOF NWD-SHIFTED VERSION OF OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM EARLIER MCS ACTIVITY. STG SFC HEATING...POCKETS OF RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE...AND SOMEWHAT ELONGATED HODOGRAPHS FROM ELY/NELY FLOW ALONG AND N OF BOUNDARY WILL SUPPORT POTENTIAL FOR SVR FROM ANY TSTMS THAT DO DEVELOP. MODIFIED FCST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST MLCAPE 2000-3000 J/KG IS POSSIBLE GIVEN 8-9 DEG C LOW/MIDDLE-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...ATOP WELL-MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER. HOWEVER...SUSTAINED/SFC-BASED CONVECTION IS IN DOUBT DUE TO COMBINATION OF 1. DECREASING LIFT/INCREASINGLY SHALLOW SLOPE OF BOUNDARY ABOVE SFC...AND 2. STG CAPPING AT BASE OF EML...WHICH MAY SUPPRESS DEVELOPMENT ALTOGETHER. FOR NOW...WILL KEEP UNCONDITIONAL RISK MRGL.

sections.title: SRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: ISOLATED STG-SVR TSTMS ARE POSSIBLE TODAY AS STRONGLY HEATED/MIXED BOUNDARY LAYERS DEVELOP AND MLCINH WEAKENS. DAMAGING GUSTS ARE POSSIBLE...WITH DOWNDRAFT ACCELERATION ENCOURAGED AMIDST STG SUBCLOUD EVAPORATIONAL POTENTIAL. WEAKNESS OF LOW/MIDDLE-LEVEL WINDS AND SHEAR EACH WILL LIMIT OVERALL STORM ORGANIZATION. COVERAGE/DURATION APPEAR TOO LOW FOR MORE THAN MRGL UNCONDITIONAL RISK ATTM. ..EDWARDS/COOK.. 07/07/2016

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL ONCE AGAIN OCCUR OVER SEVERAL AREAS OF THE COUNTRY THROUGH EARLY FRIDAY. STORMS WITH HAIL...WIND...AND PERHAPS A COUPLE TORNADOES APPEAR MOST PROBABLE LATER TODAY INTO TONIGHT FROM PARTS OF MINNESOTA SOUTHWEST INTO PARTS OF IOWA...EASTERN NEBRASKA AND MISSOURI. OTHER STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WITH LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND ARE EXPECTED FROM THE TENNESSEE AND LOWER OHIO VALLEYS TO THE MID- AND SOUTH-ATLANTIC COAST. sections.title: UPR MS VLY TO CNTRL PLNS LATER TODAY/TNGT
sections.text: IN WAKE OF SUBSTANTIAL SQLN MCS THAT CROSSED THE REGION OVNGT...MOIST/SSWLY LOW-LVL FLOW AND SFC HEATING SHOULD SUPPORT SUFFICIENT DESTABILIZATION TO PROMOTE VIGOROUS AFTN/EVE STM DEVELOPMENT ALONG COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH NRN PLNS UPR TROUGH. THIS DEVELOPMENT MOST LIKELY WILL OCCUR FROM SW MN/FAR ERN SD SSW INTO ERN NEB/WRN IA. DEVELOPMENT ALSO MAY BE ENHANCED IN FAR ERN NEB NEAR INTERSECTION OF MCS OUTFLOW BNDRY WITH FRONT. 40-50 KT WSWLY DEEP SHEAR ATTENDANT TO AMPLIFYING UPR TROUGH AND LIGHT BUT BACKED NEAR-SFC FLOW MAY YIELD A FEW SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL/DMGG WIND AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO OR TWO BEFORE THE STORMS EVOLVE INTO ONE OR MORE CLUSTERS. THE CLUSTERS SHOULD PERSIST AND MOVE/DEVELOP EWD INTO THE NIGHT...ESPECIALLY OVER SRN/WRN IA SWD INTO MO...WHERE NOCTURNALLY ENHANCED SWLY LLJ WILL TAP DEEP EML NOW OVER THE SRN PLNS. SOME OF THIS ACTIVITY IN A WEAKENED STATE MAY REACH PARTS OF WI/IL EARLY FRI.

sections.title: LWR OH/TN VLYS TODAY
sections.text: SFC HEATING OF VRY MOIST AIR /AOA 2-INCH PW/ SHOULD PROMOTE SOME REJUVENATION OF OVNGT MCS NOW IN SE MO/SRN IL ESEWD INTO PARTS OF KY/TN. EXTENSIVE OVERTURNING IN RECENT DAYS ACROSS REGION...AND DISPLACEMENT OF MCS FROM STRONGER WLY FLOW ALOFT...SHOULD LIMIT OVERALL STRENGTH/EXTENT OF SVR THREAT.

sections.title: SERN STATES TO MID-ATLANTIC TODAY
sections.text: RESIDUAL MCV ASSOCIATED WITH YESTERDAYS MCS IN THE TN VLY IS NOW OVER SRN WV...WITH A TRAILING LOBE OF VORTICITY EXTENDING SW INTO THE SRN APPALACHIANS. HEATING AND ASCENT AHEAD OF THESE FEATURES MAY SUPPORT SOME DEGREE OF UPSCALE DEVELOPMENT OF DIURNAL STMS FORMING OVER ERN PORTIONS OF THE PIEDMONT AND THE CSTL PLN FROM THE DELMARVA PENINSULA SW INTO THE CAROLINAS AND GA. THE 1000M FLOW DOES NOT...HOWEVER...APPEAR AS CONFLUENT AS WAS THE CASE THE PAST TWO DAYS...WHEN PARTS OF THE REGION EXPERIENCED CONSIDERABLE SUBSEQUENT CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING. THUS...CONFIDENCE IS NOT HIGH THAT PARTS OF SOUTHEAST/EAST-CNTRL STATES ULTIMATELY WILL SEE A SUSTAINED/ORGANIZED SVR THREAT WARRANTING INTRODUCTION OF A SLGT RISK.

sections.title: CNTRL/SRN HIGH PLNS LATE THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: ISOLD STMS WITH LOCALLY DMGG GUSTS ONCE AGAIN MAY OCCUR ALONG THE ERN FRINGE OF DEEPLY-MIXED ENVIRONMENT FROM WRN KS SWD INTO W TX. SUCH ACTIVITY MAY BE MOST CONCENTRATED IN NW KS/NE CO/SE WY/NW NEB...AND OVER SW/W-CNTRL TX...WHERE LOW-LVL CONVERGENCE SHOULD BE GREATEST. ..CORFIDI/GLEASON.. 07/07/2016

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY TO CENTRAL PLAINS
sections.text: MINOR OVERALL ADJUSTMENTS TO PROBABILITIES THIS OUTLOOK. 18Z TOPEKA RAOB SAMPLED A 700-MB TEMPERATURE OF 16 DEG C WITH MEAN MIXING RATIOS ONLY AROUND 11 G/KG. RICHER BOUNDARY-LAYER MOISTURE REMAINS SUPPRESSED SOUTH ACROSS SOUTHEAST KS INTO FAR SOUTHWEST MO...BUT IS EMANATING NORTHWARD. GIVEN A WEAKLY CONVERGENT AND MESSY SURFACE PATTERN WITH MANY ILL-DEFINED AREAS OF CONFLUENCE FROM EASTERN NEB INTO SOUTHERN MN...CONFIDENCE IS LOW IN HOW CONVECTION WILL EVOLVE ACROSS THIS REGION INTO THE EVENING. SUSPECT THAT A NOCTURNAL MCS MAY BECOME ESTABLISHED FARTHER SOUTH OF THIS ACTIVITY OVER FAR EASTERN KS AND MO WITHIN THE EXIT REGION OF THE SOUTHERN PLAINS/OZARK PLATEAU LOW-LEVEL JET.

sections.title: KY/TN
sections.text: MAINTAINING UP TO ENHANCED RISK PROBS AHEAD OF THE LONG-LIVED MCS CURRENTLY CENTERED ON WESTERN KY. THIS MCS MAY TURN MORE SOUTHEASTERLY IN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS ALONG THE MLCAPE GRADIENT GIVEN SUBSTANTIALLY WEAKER INSTABILITY OVER THE DESTABILIZATION OWING TO AN MCV REMNANT FROM THE MCS ON WEDNESDAY.

GREENVILLE-SPARTANBURG VWP DATA SAMPLED A BELT OF 50-KT FLOW NEAR 4-KM AGL SOUTH OF THE MID-LEVEL IMPULSE CROSSING THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS. GIVEN WIDESPREAD 90S SURFACE TEMPERATURES AHEAD OF THE CELLS /YIELDING MODERATE BUOYANCY/...SETUP SHOULD FOSTER A RISK FOR WIDELY SCATTERED DAMAGING WINDS.

sections.text: MADE A MODEST EXPANSION TO THE MARGINAL RISK OVER THE REGION PER ONGOING CU TRENDS. ..GRAMS.. 07/07/2016 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1154 AM CDT THU JUL 07 2016/

sections.text: ZONAL FLOW WILL ONCE AGAIN PERSIST OVER THE NRN HALF OF THE NATION WHILE FLAT RIDGE CONTINUES FROM NRN MEXICO TO OFF THE FL ATLANTIC CST. mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS PERSISTS THIS MORNING INTO EASTERN AND SOUTHERN MO...AND ADJACENT PARTS OF WEST-CENTRAL AND SOUTHWEST IL AS A LARGE BOWING LINE OF STORMS ADVANCES TO THE SOUTHEAST AT 40-45 KT. TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED AS A NEW SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL LIKELY NEED TO BE ISSUED LATER THIS MORNING TO THE SOUTHEAST OF WW 346. THE NORTHERN EXTENT OF THE LINE OF STORMS MOVING THROUGH NORTHEAST MO AND FAR SOUTHEAST IA WILL POSE SOME SEVERE RISK AS IT MOVES INTO ADJACENT WEST-CENTRAL IL THROUGH 14Z. SEVERE-WEATHER THREAT SHOULD THEN TEND TO WEAKEN AS IT MOVES FARTHER EAST INTO CENTRAL IL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LARGE BOWING COMPLEX OF STORMS CONTINUES TO ADVANCE TO THE SOUTHEAST AT 40-45 KT ACROSS CENTRAL MO WITH A 48-KT GUST OBSERVED AT COU AT 1202Z. AT THIS FORWARD SPEED...THE LINE OF STORMS WILL MOVE INTO THE STL METRO AREA BY 14Z AND EXTEND ALONG A LINE THROUGH WASHINGTON TO TEXAS AND WRIGHT COUNTIES MO. THE OBJECTIVELY ANALYZED INSTABILITY GRADIENT EXTENDED SOUTHEAST FROM THE ONGOING LINE OF STORMS...FAVORING THE EXPECTED SOUTHEAST STORM MOTION...WITH THE BOW EXITING WW 346 INTO FAR SOUTHEAST MO AND FAR SOUTHERN IL BY 15Z. DOWNSTREAM SURFACE HEATING OF VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER INTO THIS LATTER AREA WILL SUPPORT FURTHER DESTABILIZATION SUCH THAT A NEW SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED LATER THIS MORNING INTO THE AFTERNOON ACROSS SOUTHEAST MO/SOUTHERN IL INTO PARTS OF WESTERN KY/TN. FARTHER NORTH...THE PORTION OF THE LINE OF STORMS CURRENTLY MOVING INTO WEST-CENTRAL IL WAS TRACKING TO THE EAST AT 30-35 KT. AN ISOLATED SEVERE WIND THREAT WILL BE POSSIBLE...THOUGH THE SEVERE RISK SHOULD TEMPORALLY DIMINISH AS THIS LINE OF STORMS EXITS THE NORTHEAST PART OF WW 346 INTO CENTRAL IL. THE 12Z ILX SOUNDING INDICATED A STOUT CAP. THE CURRENT EASTWARD SPEED OF THE STORMS TOWARD CENTRAL IL WILL LIKELY OUTRUN THE ABILITY OF THE AIR MASS TO DESTABILIZE SUFFICIENTLY TO SUPPORT AN ORGANIZED SEVERE WEATHER THREAT FROM MID-LATE MORNING. ..PETERS.. 07/07/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT WILL INCREASE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE LOWER OH VALLEY INTO NWRN TN. DAMAGING WINDS ARE THE MAIN THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: REMNANTS OF OVERNIGHT MCS HAVE PROGRESSED INTO THE MID MS VALLEY REGION. STRONGER REFLECTIVITY IS ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THIS ACTIVITY AND CURRENTLY EXTENDS FROM SERN IL INTO SERN MO. EWD MOVEMENT ALONG THE LEADING EDGE IS ROUGHLY 35KT...THROUGH HIGHER SPEEDS ARE LIKELY WITH BOW-TYPE SURGE NEAR CGI. AS BOUNDARY LAYER WARMS CONVECTION SHOULD GRADUALLY INTENSIFY INTO A WELL-ORGANIZED SQUALL LINE. WW WILL BE ISSUED SOON TO ACCOUNT FOR DAMAGING WIND THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT SHOULD INCREASE OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS...WITH LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS...AND PERHAPS AN ISOLATED TORNADO ALL POSSIBLE. WW ISSUANCE IS LIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AS AN UPPER TROUGH MOVES EWD OVER THE NRN PLAINS...LARGE SCALE ASCENT AHEAD OF THIS FEATURE WILL OVERSPREAD A DESTABILIZING LOW-LEVEL AIRMASS ACROSS SRN/CNTRL MN INTO WRN/CNTRL IA AND ERN NEB. A SEWD/EWD MOVING COLD FRONT WILL LIKELY SERVE AS THE PRIMARY LOW-LEVEL FORCING MECHANISM FOR CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT. A WARM FRONT EXTENDS EWD ACROSS CNTRL MN FROM A SFC LOW OVER WRN MN. AN ARCING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM OVERNIGHT CONVECTION IS EVIDENT ON VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY FROM THE MO/IA BORDER INTO WRN IA/ERN NEB...WHERE IT INTERSECTS THE COLD FRONT. AIRMASS RECOVERY IS WELL UNDERWAY ACROSS MOST OF THE MCD AREA...AS DIURNAL HEATING HAS WARMED SFC TEMPERATURES INTO THE UPPER 70S TO LOWER 80S. SUFFICIENT LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE REMAINS IN PLACE ACROSS THIS REGION AS WELL PER AREA 12Z SOUNDINGS AND RECENT SFC OBSERVATIONS. A MID-LEVEL JET MAXIMUM ASSOCIATED WITH THE UPPER TROUGH WILL MOVE OVER THE MCD AREA THROUGH THE REST OF THE AFTERNOON...SUPPORTING EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR VALUES OF 40-50 KT. THIS SHEAR COMBINED WITH SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT WILL ENCOURAGE INITIAL SUPERCELL THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT...WITH AN ATTENDANT LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND THREAT. AN ISOLATED TORNADO MAY ALSO BE POSSIBLE...PARTICULARLY NEAR THE WARM FRONT WHERE LOW-LEVEL WINDS ARE MORE BACKED TO THE S/SE. GIVEN THE LINEAR NATURE OF THE LOW-LEVEL FORCING /COLD FRONT/...UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A MCS APPEARS PROBABLE WITH TIME. THIS WOULD ENHANCE THE DAMAGING WIND THREAT INTO THE EVENING HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DAMAGING WINDS ARE EXPECTED ALONG FAST-MOVING SQUALL LINE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WELL-DEVELOPED SQUALL LINE HAS FORMED ALONG LEADING EDGE OF LONG-LIVED MCS THAT HAS PROGRESSED INTO THE SRN OH VALLEY/TN VALLEY REGION. THIS STRONG BAND OF STORMS IS SURGING ESEWD AT ROUGHLY 40KT WITH NEW CONVECTION EVOLVING ALONG THE KY/TN BORDER IMMEDIATELY AHEAD OF THIS ACTIVITY WHERE AIR MASS HAS DESTABILIZED SIGNIFICANTLY. LARGER MCS MAY ULTIMATELY EVOLVE WITH THIS CLUSTER AS IT PROPAGATES INTO SCNTRL KY/NCNTRL TN. ..DARROW.. 07/07/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND THREAT MAY DEVELOP OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. WW ISSUANCE IS UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN ISOLATED THUNDERSTORM HAS RECENTLY DEVELOPED IN SERN LINCOLN/WRN DAWSON COUNTIES IN NEB ALONG A TRAILING COLD FRONT. THIS FRONT SHOULD CONTINUE MOVING SLOWLY SWD/SEWD THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF THE AFTERNOON AS AN UPPER TROUGH EVIDENT ON WATER VAPOR SATELLITE IMAGERY MOVES EWD OVER THE NRN PLAINS. VISIBLE SATELLITE SHOWS BUILDING CU ALONG THE COLD FRONT IN SRN NEB...AND EXTENDING INTO FAR SERN WY/WRN NEB. ALTHOUGH THE BETTER LARGE SCALE ASCENT AND LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE SHOULD REMAIN DISPLACED TO THE E OF THIS AREA...AT LEAST ISOLATED CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT MAY OCCUR. 19Z RAP MESOANALYSIS SUGGESTS STRONG INSTABILITY IS PRESENT ACROSS THE MCD AREA ALONG/S OF THE COLD FRONT. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR VALUES OF 40-50 KT WILL SUPPORT UPDRAFT ROTATION WITH ANY STORMS THAT DO FORM. ISOLATED INSTANCES OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WOULD BE THE MAIN THREATS THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF THE AFTERNOON...AND PERHAPS CONTINUING INTO THE EARLY EVENING. DUE TO THE EXPECTED ISOLATED NATURE OF THE SEVERE THREAT...WW ISSUANCE IS UNLIKELY AT THIS TIME.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: GUSTY WINDS WILL BE NOTED WITH A FEW STRONG STORMS THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG BOUNDARY-LAYER HEATING HAS CONTRIBUTED TO MODEST BUOYANCY FROM SERN VA INTO SC THIS AFTERNOON WHERE SFC TEMPERATURES HAVE WARMED INTO THE LOWER 90S. OVER THE LAST HOUR OR SO...ISOLATED STRONG STORMS HAVE FORMED ALONG LEADING EDGE OF THICKER CLOUD CANOPY AHEAD OF WEAK SHORT-WAVE TROUGH. THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD PROPAGATE INTO REGIONS WHERE LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE RELATIVELY STEEP...ON THE ORDER OF 8 C/KM. GUSTY WINDS ARE THE MAIN THREAT WITH THESE STORMS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A BRIEF/ISOLATED TORNADO OR TWO ALONG WITH SMALL HAIL AND STRONG/GUSTY WINDS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE THROUGH THE LATE AFTERNOON. DUE TO THE MARGINAL/ISOLATED NATURE OF THE SEVERE THREAT...WW ISSUANCE IS UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: GENERALLY SHALLOW CONVECTION HAS DEVELOPED ALONG AN INVERTED SFC TROUGH ACROSS N-CNTRL INTO ERN ND/NWRN MN AHEAD OF AN UPPER TROUGH LOCATED OVER THE ND/MT BORDER AS OF 20Z. SOME WEAK LOW-LEVEL ROTATION HAS BEEN NOTED WITH SEVERAL OF THESE THUNDERSTORMS PER AREA RADAR IMAGERY OVER THE PAST HOUR OR SO...WITH MULTIPLE REPORTS OF FUNNEL CLOUDS. THIS REGION REMAINS DISPLACED TO THE N OF A COLD FRONT AND BETTER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE ACROSS SRN MN. IN ADDITION...WIDESPREAD CLOUDINESS HAS TEMPERED DIURNAL HEATING ACROSS MUCH OF THE MCD AREA THUS FAR. RAP MESOANALYSIS ESTIMATES MLCAPE GENERALLY IN THE 500-1000 J/KG RANGE ALONG THE SFC TROUGH WHERE CONVECTIVE ACTIVITY IS ONGOING. LATEST VWP/S FROM KMBX AND KMVX SHOW LITTLE VEERING OF LOW-LEVEL WINDS WITH HEIGHT...AND SMALL 0-1 AND 0-3 SRH. REGARDLESS...GIVEN THE MULTIPLE FUNNEL CLOUD REPORTS RECEIVED THUS FAR...A BRIEF/ISOLATED TORNADO ALONG WITH SMALL HAIL AND PERHAPS SOME STRONG/GUSTY WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF THE AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED STRONG STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO FORM LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND MAY PRODUCE MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL OR WIND GUSTS FOR A BRIEF PERIOD BEFORE DISSIPATING DURING THE EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN EXTREMELY HOT AIR MASS EXISTS WITHIN A BROAD SFC TROUGH FROM THE PANHANDLES SWWD ACROSS WRN TX WITH TEMPERATURES IN EXCESS OF 105 F AND A DEEPLY-MIXED BL. A LARGE HIGH-BASED CU FIELD WAS EVIDENT ACROSS MUCH OF THE REGION AS WELL WITH ONLY WEAK RADAR ECHOES. HOWEVER...MORE SUBSTANTIAL MOISTURE EXISTS FROM WRN OK INTO NWRN TX WITH MID 60S F DEWPOINTS RESULTING IN 2000-3000 J/KG MLCAPE. THE WRN PERIPHERY OF THIS MOIST AIR MASS IS LIKELY TO BECOME UNCAPPED...AND TCU ARE ALREADY NOTED ON VIS IMAGERY SW OF CDS AS OF 22Z. WITH TIME...A SW-NE ORIENTED ZONE OF SCATTERED STORMS IS EXPECTED TO FORM...AND A FEW UPDRAFTS MAY BECOME STRONG ENOUGH TO PRODUCE MARGINAL HAIL AND LOCALIZED MICROBURSTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SMALL CLUSTER OF STORMS IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST AS IT DEVELOPS SEWD THROUGH EARLY EVENING. ISOLATED SEVERE WIND GUSTS AND HAIL ARE ANTICIPATED...BUT A WATCH IS PROBABLY NOT NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SMALL AREA OF STORMS HAS FORMED OVER NERN CO IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE UPPER TROUGH AND STRONG HEATING AND MAY GAIN STRENGTH AS SFC WINDS VEER TO ELY AND THE STORMS ENCOUNTER AN EVER INCREASINGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS TO THE SE. STORM LONGEVITY SHOULD BE AIDED BY AMPLE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR FOR FORWARD PROPAGATION. HOWEVER...CAPPING WILL EVENTUALLY BECOME A CONCERN AFTER SUNSET.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO DMGG WIND GUSTS REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS WW 350 IN ASSOCIATION WITH A MCS. THIS THREAT MAY EXTEND BEYOND THE ERN EDGE OF THE WATCH AROUND 00Z...AND TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE NEW WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MCS CONTINUES TO MOVE ESEWD ACROSS MIDDLE/ERN TN AND SERN KY AT AROUND 30 KT...AND CONTINUES TO EXHIBIT THE POTENTIAL FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS. SWRN FLANK OF THE MCS WILL HAVE ACCESS TO THE HOTTEST/MOST UNSTABLE AIR IN PLACE FROM NRN GA INTO ERN TN...WHERE TEMPERATURES ARE IN THE UPPER 80S TO LOW 90S F. COOLER TEMPERATURES AND A MORE STABLE AIR MASS EXIST OVER/E OF THE HIGHER TERRAIN IN WRN NC...WHERE SCATTERED SHOWERS/TSTMS HAVE BEEN OCCURRING OVER THE PAST SEVERAL HRS. REGIONAL VWP DATA SHOW 20-40 KT OF W-NWLY FLOW WITHIN THE LOWEST 3 KM AGL...AND WILL BE SUFFICIENT TO MAINTAIN STRONG TO MARGINALLY SVR CONVECTION FOR THE NEXT FEW HRS...BUT THE LOSS OF DIURNAL HEATING SHOULD EVENTUALLY RESULT IN A GENERAL WEAKENING TREND THROUGH THE LATE EVENING. HOWEVER...CONVECTIVE TRENDS CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR A POTENTIAL DMGG WIND THREAT EXTENDING E OF WW 350...IN WHICH CASE A SMALL WW MAY BE CONSIDERED INTO NRN GA AND POSSIBLY FAR WRN NC AND SC WITHIN THE NEXT HR OR SO.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERAL TSTM CLUSTERS CONTINUE TO EXHIBIT THE POTENTIAL FOR STRONG TO LOCALLY DMGG WIND GUSTS ACROSS CNTRL/ERN PORTIONS OF THE CAROLINAS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTIVE TRENDS SHOW A GRADUAL INCREASE IN TSTM COVERAGE ACROSS THE PIEDMONT TOWARDS THE COASTAL PLAIN OF THE CAROLINAS...WITH A FEW MORE ORGANIZED CLUSTERS HAVING EVOLVED. THIS IS OCCURRING WITHIN A BELT OF STRONG LOW-MIDLEVEL FLOW ALONG THE SRN PERIPHERY OF A SHORTWAVE TROUGH CENTERED OVER SWRN VA...AND REGIONAL VWPS CONTINUE TO SAMPLE 20-40 KT OF FLOW WITHIN THE LOWEST 3 KM AGL. ADDITIONALLY...TEMPERATURES REMAIN IN THE LOW-MID 90S F WHERE THE AIR MASS IS RELATIVELY UNDISTURBED...AND IS CONTINUING TO SUPPORT MLCAPE VALUES OF 1000-2000 J/KG. GIVEN THE STRONG FLOW AND WARM/MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER...STRONG TO LOCALLY SVR STORMS SHOULD PERSIST OVER THE NEXT COUPLE HRS...BEFORE AN ANTICIPATED WEAKENING TREND BEGINS IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE LOSS OF DIURNAL HEATING. ..ROGERS.. 07/07/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW SEVERE STORMS REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS THE WATCH AREA FOR A FEW MORE HOURS WITH MARGINAL HAIL AND WIND.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS HAVE GENERALLY SHOWN WEAKENING TREND OVER THE PAST HOUR EXCEPT FOR ACTIVITY OVER SWRN IA. SFC WINDS REMAIN WEAK EXCEPT FOR NEAR THE COLD FRONT WITH STORMS AHEAD OF THE FRONT BEING SUPPORTED MAINLY BY STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND GOOD MID TO UPPER LEVEL SHEAR. AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER COOLS...INSTABILITY WILL WEAKEN A BIT. SOME ADDITIONAL STORM ACTIVITY IS POSSIBLE ALONG THE COLD FRONT AS IT SURGES EWD LATER THIS EVENING...BUT LACK OF ANY SUBSTANTIAL LOW-LEVEL JET SUGGESTS LOW SEVERE CHANCES INTO THE EVENING. ..JEWELL.. 07/07/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE THIS EVENING...WITH SEVERE HAIL AND WIND POSSIBLE. A WATCH COULD BE REQUIRED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS ARE BEGINNING TO FORM OVER E CNTRL KS WHERE AN EXTREMELY MOIST AND UNSTABLE AIR MASS EXISTS WITH MLCAPE APPROACHING 4000 J/KG PER 00Z TOP SOUNDING. GLANCING WARM ADVECTION WITH A SWLY 850 MB JET MAY PROVE SUFFICIENT FOR AN EXPANSION OF STORMS WHICH COULD INTENSIFY TO SEVERE LIMITS BASED MAINLY ON UPDRAFT STRENGTH AS SHEAR IS SUFFICIENT BUT MARGINAL. HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WOULD BE POSSIBLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS CONTINUES ACROSS THE WATCH AREA ESPECIALLY OVER ERN KS AND INTO SWRN MO WITH SEVERE WIND...HAIL...AND VERY HEAVY RAINS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SUPERCELL CLUSTER WHICH EARLIER PRODUCED A TORNADO OVER SERN KS HAS BECOME A LITTLE MORE DISORGANIZED WITH LESS ROTATION NOTED ON RADAR. THESE CELLS WERE PRODUCING EXTREMELY HEAVY RAINS AND LIKELY MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL ALONG WITH STRONG WINDS. STRONG MOISTURE FLUX INTO THIS CONVECTIVE CLUSTER VIA THE LOW-LEVEL JET WILL LIKELY ALLOW THE THREAT TO PERSIST FOR SEVERAL HOURS ACROSS SERN KS INTO SWRN MO. OTHER CELLS WERE SLOWER TO DEVELOP INTO CNTRL MO...BUT STRONG INSTABILITY MAY SUPPORT A FEW TALL STORMS CAPABLE OF WIND OR HAIL LATER TONIGHT. ..JEWELL.. 07/08/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: VIGOROUS THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT CAPABLE OF GENERATING OCCASIONAL LOCALIZED SEVERE WIND GUSTS REMAINS POSSIBLE ANOTHER COUPLE OF HOURS WITHIN A CORRIDOR ACROSS NORTHWEST THROUGH NORTH CENTRAL OKLAHOMA. UNLESS MORE SUBSTANTIVE UPSCALE GROWTH OCCURS THAN IS CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED...A WATCH MAY NOT BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MID/UPPER SUPPORT FOR THE ONGOING VIGOROUS SMALL CLUSTER OF STORMS NEAR GAGE OK IS UNCLEAR...IF THERE IS ANY. HOWEVER...ACTIVITY IS GENERALLY DEVELOPING EASTWARD ALONG A ZONE OF ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE AND WARM ADVECTION...WHICH EXTENDS EAST NORTHEASTWARD TOWARD THE PONCA CITY AREA. ALTHOUGH WESTERLY DEEP LAYER MEAN FLOW IS RATHER MODEST...ON THE ORDER OF 25 KTS...IT DOES APPEAR NEAR THE NOSE OF A NOCTURNALLY PEAKING SOUTHERLY LOW-LEVEL JET /30-40 KT AT 850 MB/. THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES CHARACTERIZED BY SEASONABLY HIGH MOISTURE CONTENT...SIZABLE CAPE AND AT LEAST MODESTLY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES CERTAINLY REMAINS CONDUCIVE TO DOWNBURSTS. AND LOCALIZED STRONG SURFACE GUSTS OCCASIONALLY EXCEEDING SEVERE LIMITS MAY CONTINUE THROUGH THE 08-09Z TIME FRAME. EAST OF PONCA CITY...THE POSSIBLE INFLUENCE OF CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW ASSOCIATED WITH THE MORE SUBSTANTIVE STORM CLUSTER NOW OVER SOUTHWESTERN MISSOURI REMAINS UNCLEAR.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONVECTIVE SYSTEM APPEARS TO BE WEAKENING SUFFICIENTLY THAT A NEW WATCH IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED. REMAINING VALID PORTION OF WW 353 MAY BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE AT 07Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SUBSTANTIAL WEAKENING OF THE ONGOING MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM IS EVIDENT IN MOST OBSERVATIONAL DATA /RADAR...LIGHTNING...AND SATELLITE/. ACTIVITY APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN SUPPORTED BY AN AREA OF ENHANCED FORCING FOR LARGE-SCALE ASCENT...PARTICULARLY ASSOCIATED WITH LOWER/MID TROPOSPHERIC WARM ADVECTION...WHICH MAY BE IN THE PROCESS OF WEAKENING. GUSTY WINDS MAY CONTINUE TO ACCOMPANY CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW ASSOCIATED WITH THE REMNANT CONVECTIVE SYSTEM ANOTHER SEVERAL HOURS...AS IT CONTINUES EAST SOUTHEASTWARD ON THE SUPPRESSED NORTHEASTERN PERIPHERY OF WARM ELEVATED MIXED LAYER AIR EMERGING FROM THE INTERMOUNTAIN REGION. HOWEVER...SEVERE WIND POTENTIAL SEEMS TO BE DIMINISHING. ..KERR.. 07/08/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ANY CONTINUING RISK FOR SEVERE WIND/HAIL IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN RELATIVELY ISOLATED NORTHEAST/EAST OF LAMAR CO INTO PARTS OF SOUTHWEST KANSAS DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO...BEFORE DIMINISHING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ON THE TRAILING/SOUTHWESTERN PERIPHERY OF A SIGNIFICANT MID-LATITUDE SHORT WAVE TROUGH...NOW PROGRESSING INTO THE UPPER MIDWEST/GREAT LAKES REGION...AN AREA OF LOW-LEVEL WARM ADVECTION APPEARS TO HAVE PROVIDED SUPPORT FOR VIGOROUS THUNDERSTORM NOW PASSING TO THE NORTH OF LAMAR. THIS PROBABLY HAS BEEN ENHANCED BY FAIRLY STRONG AND SEASONABLY MOIST EASTERLY UPSLOPE FLOW TO THE NORTH OF THE ARKANSAS VALLEY...CONTRIBUTING TO SUFFICIENT SHEAR AND INSTABILITY TO MAINTAIN A SEVERE HAIL/WIND THREAT THE PAST FEW HOURS. SOME RECENT WEAKENING...OR AT LEAST SHRINKING...OF THE STRONGEST CONVECTION HAS ALREADY BECOME EVIDENT. AND THE LATEST RAPID REFRESH SUGGESTS THAT THE SUPPORTING FORCING WILL WEAKEN CONSIDERABLY BY 10/11Z...AS IT SPREADS EAST SOUTHEASTWARD INTO SOUTHWESTERN KANSAS. AS THIS OCCURS...ANY APPRECIABLE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT SEEMS LIKELY TO DIMINISH BY THIS TIME...IF NOT BEFORE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS DEVELOPING IMMEDIATELY E OF THE CO FRONT RANGE MAY BE LOCALLY SVR EARLY THIS MORNING. WW ISSUANCE IS PRESENTLY UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: PERSISTENT...MODERATE...MOIST UPSLOPE FLOW CONTINUES UP TO THE E SLOPES OF THE CO ROCKIES...WITH THE PUEBLO SFC OBSERVATION INDICATING MIDDLE 60S DEWPOINTS -- WHICH IS QUITE MOIST FOR THIS ELEVATION. WITH TEMPERATURES ONLY HAVING MODESTLY COOLED INTO THE MIDDLE 70S...NOCTURNAL MLCINH HAS BEEN SLOW TO INCREASE. AND...WITH WATER-VAPOR LOOPS IMPLYING THE GLANCING INFLUENCE OF A SUBTLE MID-LEVEL SPEED MAX PRIMARY SPREADING ACROSS LOCATIONS FARTHER N...CONVECTIVE CORES HAVE BEEN STRENGTHENING IN EL PASO AND PUEBLO COUNTIES JUST E OF THE FRONT RANGE. ADDITIONAL TSTMS MAY FORM IN THE LOW-INHIBITION ENVIRONMENT AS SUBTLE LARGE-SCALE ASCENT CONTINUES. WITH THE 00Z RAOB AT DNR INDICATING STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES THAT SURMOUNT THE MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER SUPPORTING AROUND 1000-2000 J/KG OF MLCAPE...INTENSE CONVECTION MAY OCCUR THROUGH THE NEXT FEW HOURS. VERTICALLY VEERING FLOW THROUGH THE LOWEST 3 KM AGL...COMBINED WITH AROUND 40 KT OF 0-6-KM SHEAR...WILL LIKELY SUPPORT A FEW SUSTAINED/ORGANIZED CORES WITH ISOLATED SVR HAIL POSSIBLE. A WEAKNESS IN THE 2-3-KM-AGL FLOW WILL TEND TO FOSTER UPDRAFT SEEDING AND LIMIT OPPORTUNITIES FOR LOW-LEVEL MESOCYCLONES TO BE SUSTAINED. IF AMALGAMATING COLD POOLS WERE TO FOSTER LOCALIZED UPSCALE GROWTH...THE RISK FOR LOCALLY SVR WIND GUSTS COULD INCREASE.
